verses.en: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the LORD, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.
verses.pt: Ouvi isto, casa de Jacó, que vos chamais pelo nome de Israel, e saístes das águas de Judá; que jurais pelo nome do SENHOR, e fazeis menção do Deus de Israel, porém não em verdade, nem em justiça.
verses.en_web: “Hear this, house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, and have come out of the waters of Judah. You swear by Yahweh’s name, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to this, O family of Jacob, you who are named by the name of Israel, and have come out of the body of Judah; who take oaths by the name of the Lord, and make use of the name of the God of Israel, but not truly and not in good faith.

verses.en: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The LORD of hosts is his name.
verses.pt: E até da santa cidade se chamam; e confiam no Deus de Israel; EU-SOU dos exércitos é o seu nome.
verses.en_web: (for they call themselves citizens of the holy city, and rely on the God of Israel; Yahweh of Armies is his name):
verses.en_bbe: For they say that they are of the holy town, and put their faith in the God of Israel: the Lord of armies is his name.

verses.en: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass.
verses.pt: As coisas passadas desde antes anunciei, procederam da minha boca, e eu as declarei publicamente; rapidamente eu as fiz, e elas aconteceram.
verses.en_web: I have declared the former things from of old; yes, they went out of my mouth, and I revealed them. I did them suddenly, and they happened.
verses.en_bbe: I gave word in the past of the things which came about; they came from my mouth, and I made them clear: suddenly I did them, and they came about.

verses.en: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;
verses.pt: Porque eu sabia que tu eras obstinado, e teu pescoço era um nervo de ferro, e tua testa de bronze.
verses.en_web: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow brass;
verses.en_bbe: Because I saw that your heart was hard, and that your neck was an iron cord, and your brow brass;

verses.en: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.
verses.pt: Por isso eu anunciei a ti com antecedência, e te declarei antes que acontecesse, para que não viesses a dizer: Meu ídolo fez estas coisas, ou minha imagem de escultura ou imagem de fundição, foi ela que isso ordenou.
verses.en_web: therefore I have declared it to you from of old; before it came to pass I showed it to you; lest you should say, ‘My idol has done them, and my engraved image, and my molten image, has commanded them.’
verses.en_bbe: For this reason I made it clear to you in the past, before it came I gave you word of it: for fear that you might say, My god did these things, and my pictured and metal images made them come about.

verses.en: Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare it? I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.
verses.pt: Já tens escutado. Olha bem para tudo isto: por acaso vós não diríeis que isto é verdade? A partir de agora eu te faço ouvir coisas novas, ocultas, e que nunca antes soubeste.
verses.en_web: You have heard it; see all this. And you, won’t you declare it? “I have shown you new things from this time, even hidden things, which you have not known.
verses.en_bbe: All this has come to your ears and you have seen it; will you not give witness to it? I am now making clear new things, even secret things, of which you had no knowledge.

verses.en: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.
verses.pt: Agora foram criadas, e não antes; e antes de hoje não as ouvistes; para que não viesses a dizer: Eis que eu já as sabia.
verses.en_web: They are created now, and not from of old; and before today you didn’t hear them; lest you should say, ‘Behold, I knew them.’
verses.en_bbe: They have only now been effected, and not in the past: and before this day they had not come to your ears; for fear that you might say, I had knowledge of them.

verses.en: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.
verses.pt: Tu não as ouviste, nem as soubeste, nem também teu ouvido havia sido aberto antes; porque eu sabia que agirias enganosamente, e que foste chamado de transgressor desde o ventre.
verses.en_web: Yes, you didn’t hear; yes, you didn’t know; yes, from of old your ear was not opened: for I knew that you dealt very treacherously, and were called a transgressor from the womb.
verses.en_bbe: Truly you had no word of them, no knowledge of them; no news of them in the past had come to your ears; because I saw how false was your behaviour, and that your heart was turned against me from your earliest days.

verses.en: For my name’s sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.
verses.pt: Por causa do meu nome adiarei a minha ira, e por louvor a mim me conterei para contigo, para que eu não venha a te eliminar.
verses.en_web: For my name’s sake, I will defer my anger, and for my praise I hold it back for you, so that I don’t cut you off.
verses.en_bbe: Because of my name I will put away my wrath, and for my praise I will keep myself from cutting you off.

verses.en: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
verses.pt: Eis que eu te purifiquei, porém não como a prata; eu te escolhi na fornalha da aflição.
verses.en_web: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.
verses.en_bbe: See, I have been testing you for myself like silver; I have put you through the fire of trouble.

verses.en: For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.
verses.pt: Por causa de mim, por causa de mim eu o farei; pois como permitiria meu nome ser profanado? E minha glória não darei a outro.
verses.en_web: For my own sake, for my own sake, I will do it; for how would my name be profaned? I will not give my glory to another.
verses.en_bbe: For myself, even because of my name, I will do it; for I will not let my name be shamed; and my glory I will not give to another.

verses.en: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
verses.pt: Ouvi-me, ó Jacó, e tu, ó Israel, por mim chamado; eu sou o mesmo; eu sou o primeiro, eu também sou o último.
verses.en_web: “Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he; I am the first, I am also the last.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to me, Jacob, and Israel, my loved one; I am he, I am the first and I am the last.

verses.en: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.
verses.pt: Também minha mão fundou a terra, e minha mão direita estendeu os céus; quando eu os chamo, logo eles juntamente aparecem.
verses.en_web: Yes, my hand has laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand has spread out the heavens. when I call to them, they stand up together.
verses.en_bbe: Yes, by my hand was the earth placed on its base, and by my right hand the heavens were stretched out; at my word they take up their places.

verses.en: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these things? The LORD hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.
verses.pt: Ajuntai-vos, todos vós, e ouvi, quem há dentre eles, anunciou estas coisas? O SENHOR o amou, e executará sua vontade contra a Babilônia, e seu braço será contra os caldeus.
verses.en_web: “Assemble yourselves, all of you, and hear; who among them has declared these things? He whom Yahweh loves will do what he likes to Babylon, and his arm will be against the Chaldeans.
verses.en_bbe: Come together, all of you, and give ear; who among you has given news of these things? the Lord's loved one will do his pleasure with Babylon, and with the seed of the Chaldaeans.

verses.en: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
verses.pt: Eu, eu mesmo tenho dito; também eu já o chamei. Eu o farei vir, e ele prosperará em seu caminho.
verses.en_web: I, even I, have spoken; yes, I have called him. I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
verses.en_bbe: I, even I, have given the word; I have sent for him: I have made him come, and have given effect to his undertakings.

verses.en: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord GOD, and his Spirit, hath sent me.
verses.pt: Achegai-vos a mim, ouvi isto: não falei em oculto desde o princípio; ao contrário,desde o tempo em que aquilo se fez, ali eu estava; e agora o Senhor DEUS me enviou, e seu Espírito.
verses.en_web: “Come near to me and hear this: “From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it happened, I was there.” Now the Lord Yahweh has sent me, with his Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: Come near to me, and give ear to this; from the start I did not keep it secret; from the time of its coming into existence I was there: and now the Lord God has sent me, and given me his spirit.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the LORD thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.
verses.pt: Assim diz o SENHOR, teu Redentor, o Santo de Israel: Eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, que te ensina o que é proveitoso, e te guia pelo caminho que deves andar.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord who takes up your cause, the Holy One of Israel, says, I am the Lord your God, who is teaching you for your profit, guiding you by the way in which you are to go.

verses.en: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:
verses.pt: Ah, se tu tivesses me dado ouvidos a meus mandamentos! Então tua paz teria sido como um rio, e tua justiça como as ondas do mar.
verses.en_web: Oh that you had listened to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.
verses.en_bbe: If only you had given ear to my orders, then your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness as the waves of the sea:

verses.en: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.
verses.pt: Também tua semente teria sido como a areia, e os que procedem do teu corpo, como suas pedrinhas, cujo nome nunca seria cortado, nem destruído de minha face.
verses.en_web: Your offspring also would have been as the sand, and the descendants of your body like its grains. His name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me.”
verses.en_bbe: Your seed would have been like the sand, and your offspring like the dust: your name would not be cut off or come to an end before me.

verses.en: Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say ye, The LORD hath redeemed his servant Jacob.
verses.pt: Saí da Babilônia, fugi dos caldeus; declarai com voz de júbilo, anunciai, e levai isto até o fim da terra; dizei: O SENHOR resgatou a seu servo Jacó!
verses.en_web: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! With a voice of singing announce this, tell it even to the end of the earth: say, “Yahweh has redeemed his servant Jacob!”
verses.en_bbe: Go out of Babylon, go in flight from the Chaldaeans; with the sound of song make it clear, give the news, let the word go out even to the end of the earth: say, The Lord has taken up the cause of his servant Jacob.

verses.en: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
verses.pt: E não tinham sede, quando ele os levava pelos desertos; fez correr para eles água da rocha; e quando ele fendia as rochas, águas manavam delas.
verses.en_web: They didn’t thirst when he led them through the deserts. He caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them. He split the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
verses.en_bbe: They had no need of water when he was guiding them through the waste lands: he made water come out of the rock for them: the rock was parted and the waters came flowing out.

verses.en: There is no peace, saith the LORD, unto the wicked.
verses.pt: Porém para os perversos não haverá paz,diz o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: “There is no peace”, says Yahweh, “for the wicked.”
verses.en_bbe: There is no peace, says the Lord, for the evil-doers.
